description: This file contains unit tests for the absl::uniform_real_distribution class, including parameter serialization, boundary conditions, statistical moments, chi-squared tests, and stability tests, specifically for the uniform_real_distribution implementation in the Abseil library.

classes.name: UniformRealDistributionTest
classes.description: Template test fixture class for testing absl::uniform_real_distribution with different real types (float, double, long double).

methods.name: ParamSerializeTest
methods.description: Tests serialization, deserialization, and parameter handling of the uniform_real_distribution, including boundary conditions and range correctness.

methods.name: ViolatesPreconditionsDeathTest
methods.description: Tests that invalid parameters cause death tests or are handled gracefully, including cases where the upper bound is less than the lower bound.

methods.name: TestMoments
methods.description: Computes and verifies statistical moments (mean, variance, skewness, kurtosis) of the distribution over a large sample.

methods.name: ChiSquaredTest50
methods.description: Performs chi-squared goodness-of-fit tests to verify uniformity of the distribution over multiple buckets.

methods.name: StabilityTest
methods.description: Checks the stability and reproducibility of the distribution's output with a fixed seed and internal state.

methods.name: AlgorithmBounds
methods.description: Verifies the boundary values generated by the distribution for various internal states, ensuring correct handling of edge cases.
